text: I'd say they're important for both physical and mental health. Green areas help to cool the city down and filter some of the pollution, which really matters in a place like Almaty, where smog is a serious problem in winter. On top of that, parks are one of the few places where people from completely different backgrounds meet for free, so they help a city feel like a community rather than just a collection of flats.

tips.en: Physical and mental health — two lines, each developed.
tips.kk: Физикалық және психикалық денсаулық — екі бағыт, әрқайсысы дамыған.
tips.ru: Физическое и психическое здоровье — две линии, каждая развита.
tips.example: important for both physical and mental health

tips.en: Smog in Almaty is a specific detail that makes a general point convincing.
tips.kk: Алматыдағы түтін — жалпы дәлелді сенімді ететін нақтылық.
tips.ru: Смог в Алматы — конкретика, которая делает общий довод убедительным.
tips.example: where smog is a serious problem in winter

questions.followUp: Should cities have more of them?
questions.question: Why are parks and public spaces important in cities?

text: They've grown enormously, especially Astana and Almaty, as people move from villages in search of work and education. You can see new residential districts appearing almost every year, along with shopping centres and wider roads. The downside is that infrastructure hasn't always kept up, so traffic jams and crowded schools have become quite common. Still, city centres are much more pedestrian-friendly than they were ten years ago.

tips.en: In search of work and education explains why, not just what changed.
tips.kk: In search of work and education — не өзгергені ғана емес, неге екені де.
tips.ru: In search of work and education — не только что изменилось, но и почему.
tips.example: as people move from villages in search of work and education

tips.en: The downside is … Still, … puts minuses and pluses in one answer.
tips.kk: The downside is … Still, … — бір жауапта кемшілік те, артықшылық та.
tips.ru: The downside is … Still, … — минусы и плюсы в одном ответе.
tips.example: The downside is that infrastructure hasn't always kept up

questions.question: How have cities in your country changed in recent years?

text: That's a difficult one, because both are basic needs in a growing city. If I had to choose, I'd probably put affordable housing first, since people need somewhere decent to live before they can enjoy a park. However, I don't think it has to be either-or. New housing projects could be required to include green areas, so developers pay for part of the public space themselves.

tips.en: If I had to choose is a polite way to still pick one side.
tips.kk: If I had to choose — бәрібір таңдаудың сыпайы тәсілі.
tips.ru: If I had to choose — вежливый способ всё-таки выбрать.
tips.example: If I had to choose, I'd probably put affordable housing first

tips.en: Instead of either-or, a compromise with a concrete detail.
tips.example: New housing projects could be required to include green areas

note.en: Buys a moment to think and sounds natural.
note.kk: Ойлануға бір сәт береді — табиғи бастама.

questions.question: Should governments spend more on public spaces or on housing?

text: Generally, yes, and I think the biggest change is among children. When my parents were young, kids played in the courtyard until it got dark, whereas now many children spend their free time indoors with a screen. Part of it is technology, of course, but parents are also more worried about safety than before, so they prefer to keep children where they can see them.

tips.en: Whereas contrasts the parents' childhood with children today.
tips.kk: Whereas ата-ананың балалық шағы мен қазіргі балаларды қарама-қарсы қояды.
tips.ru: Whereas противопоставляет детство родителей и нынешних детей.
tips.example: whereas now many children spend their free time indoors

tips.en: Part of it is … but … also gives an obvious and a less obvious cause.
tips.kk: Part of it is …, but … also — айқын себеп және онша айқын емес себеп.
tips.ru: Part of it is …, but … also — очевидная причина и менее очевидная.
tips.example: Part of it is technology, of course, but parents are also more worried about safety

note.en: The shared yard between blocks of flats.

questions.question: Do you think people spend less time outdoors than in the past?

text: It's hard to predict, but I imagine they'll be much greener and quieter. If electric and self-driving cars become the norm, we might need far fewer car parks, and that space could be turned into gardens or cycle lanes. On the other hand, cities will probably be even bigger and more crowded, so I suspect a lot of people will live in very tall buildings with less private space.

tips.en: It's hard to predict, but I imagine softly introduces a guess.
tips.kk: It's hard to predict, but I imagine — болжамды жұмсақ енгізу.
tips.ru: It's hard to predict, but I imagine — мягкое введение гипотезы.
tips.example: It's hard to predict, but I imagine

tips.en: If … become …, we might … is a conditional about the future.
tips.kk: If … become …, we might … — болашақ туралы шартты сөйлем.
tips.ru: If … become …, we might … — условное предложение о будущем.
tips.example: If electric and self-driving cars become the norm, we might need far fewer car parks
